 * Strong willingness to learn and motivation for continuous personal and professional development

 * Very good Hungarian and English skills, both written and spoken

jobs.occupation: SAP PP/QM Solution Architect & Functional Consultant (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
TroGroup is a global market leader in stamping and laser industries. Innovation and continuous development are at the heart of our corporate culture. It's our people who enable us to set new standards time and again, helping our customers worldwide achieve greater success. This is driven by employees with a pioneering spirit and a passion for teamwork.

TROGROUP GmbH is looking for a 1 SAP PP/QM Solution Architect & Functional Consultant (m/w/x) 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Lead SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing and Quality Management implementations, rollouts and transformation projects.

 * Design and optimize production planning, manufacturing and quality processes across SAP PP and QM.

 * Configure and enhance key areas such as MRP, production orders, capacity planning, inspections, quality notifications and traceability.

 * Ensure seamless integration with MM, WM/EWM, SD, CO and shop floor systems.

 * Facilitate workshops, translate business requirements into scalable solutions, and drive testing, cutover and hypercare activities.

 * Support productive systems and continuously improve manufacturing and quality processes across international sites.

YOUR PROFILE

 * Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Business Administration or a comparable qualification.

 * Several years of experience as an SAP PP/QM Consultant or Solution Architect, ideally in SAP S/4HANA environments.

 * Strong expertise in SAP PP (MRP, production planning, capacity planning, BOMs, routings) and SAP QM (inspection planning, quality inspections, notifications and certificates).

 * Solid understanding of manufacturing operations, quality management and shop floor processes.

 * Experience with cross-module integration (MM, WM/EWM, SD, CO) and interface technologies (IDoc, XML, EDI).

 * Proven experience in SAP implementation, rollout and transformation projects.

 * Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

 * Customer-oriented, communicative and comfortable working with international teams and senior stakeholders.

 * Fluent in English; German is an advantage.

Last but not least, under Austrian law, we are required to state the minimum salary for this position.

This amounts to EUR 53.241,02 gross per year for a full-time role (according to the Metal Industry collective agreement).

Don't worry - we value experience!
